answer:
Sea Limited's cash and cash equivalents (excluding restricted cash) were **US$4,158,920 thousand (approximately US$4.2 billion)** as of December 31, 2025, up from US$2,405,153 thousand as of December 31, 2024 [Sea, FY2025, p.F-7].

Note that this is distinct from the broader "cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash" figure of US$6.4 billion (US$6,419,467 thousand) cited elsewhere in the filing, which also includes restricted cash of US$2,216,733 thousand (current) plus US$43,814 thousand (non-current restricted cash) [Sea, FY2025, p.F-7; p.141].
